raw_response:
Ah, it's that time again — let me think through this year.

I've got 3 mu total. Like I always do, I split it: about 2 mu as wheat-maize double crop, and 1 mu in cotton because we need the cash income. My husband works construction in town most of the year, so it's mostly me in the fields, with my mother-in-law helping during harvest.

**Wheat (already in the ground).** I put the winter wheat in back in early October. I broadcast about 40 kg of the 15-15-15 compound per mu before ploughing as my base — that's my habit, and the extension guy at the township said 13-15 kg N per mu is enough, but I'd rather put a bit more than risk yellow wheat. In late March when it greens up I'll top-dress about 15 kg of urea per mu along with the jointing water. I plan on irrigating three times — green-up, jointing, grain-filling — unless May is wet. Last year I got about 420 kg/mu and the year before was similar, so I expect about the same.

**Maize (after wheat).** Once I cut the wheat in early June, I've got maybe 5-6 days before I need the maize in. I'll hire the neighbour with the seeder, 30 yuan per mu, and direct-seed Zhengdan 958 into the stubble. Put compound down at sowing, then top-dress urea at big-trumpet stage. Maize usually manages on rain in July-August here, but I'll keep the well ready for one irrigation if it's dry. Harvest end of September.

**Cotton.** This is the slow, fussy one. I'll plough the cotton mu in early April, lay plastic mulch, and transplant/seed around April 20th. Some of the seed I saved from last year's picking, some I'll buy fresh. Cotton eats pesticide — bollworm, aphids, maybe red spider mite — I'll spray 4 or 5 times through the summer. Picking starts late August and runs into October across three or four rounds. My sister-in-law helps pick; I pay her in a share of the lint plus meals.

Money: I've got roughly 2000 yuan set aside for inputs. Fertilizer is the biggest chunk, then cotton pesticide, then pumping. I always hold a few hundred back in case something breaks or a spray is needed.
